android.desc:
Stashfin is India’s leading fintech platform that simplifies your relationship with finance. Trusted by 40 million+ users, Stashfin offers Credit Card Bill Payments, Instant UPI Money Transfers, 24K Digital Gold, Credit Health Reports, Corporate Bonds, Personal Loans, Insurance, and more. 

1. Credit Card Bill Payments
Get assured 1% Stashcoins, redeemable as 24K Gold on Credit Card Bill Payments
Manage multiple credit cards without switching between banking apps
Pay your bills via Stashfin UPI, BHIM UPI, PhonePe, GPay, or any other UPI app
Settle your credit card outstanding without logging into your bank’s portal
Get real-time reminders & updates on your credit card bill

30+ Credit Cards Supported on Stashfin 
HDFC Bank, SBI, Axis Bank, ICICI Bank, RBL Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, IndusInd Bank, IDFC First Bank, YES Bank, Bank of Baroda, AU Small Finance Bank, Federal Bank, Citi Bank, Standard Chartered Bank, SBM Bank India Limited, DBS Bank, South Indian Bank, HSBC Bank, and all VISA, Mastercard, RuPay, Diners Club, AMEX, and Discover cards

Utility Bill Payments & Recharge, powered by Bharat Connect
Never miss a due date for electricity, water, gas, & other essentials
Covers 300+ major national & regional service providers
Instant FASTag & mobile recharges for Jio, Airtel, Vi, BSNL or other networks

2. Money Transfer via UPI Payments
Send money using a UPI ID or mobile number
Link multiple SBI, HDFC, ICICI, Axis & 140+ other bank accounts & enjoy self-transfer
Scan QR code to pay merchants 
Split bills & other payments with friends 
Set up recurring payments for bills & subscriptions
Check transaction history & account balance in real time

3. 24K Digital Gold
Secure your savings in 24K gold
Start investing with just ₹10
Track gold rate in real time
Insured locker storage powered by Augmont
Flexibility to liquidate anytime
SIP or lump sum gold investment options

4. Credit Health Report & Credit Builder
Secure better loan & credit card offers with credit builder & repair
Get detailed reports & expert tips to boost credit score

5. Corporate Bond
Earn competitive returns of upto 14.8% p.a.
Start investing with just ₹10K
Get monthly interest directly to your bank account

6. Insurance 
Low-cost, high-impact insurance plans to secure your earnings
100% digital process with a user-friendly interface
Annual insurance plans starting at ₹4/day

7. Gift Vouchers
Exclusive offers on Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, Myntra
